meta.title: Cadence
meta.description: Local-first medical ID and daily medication cadence. Your data stays on this device.

footer.privacy: Cadence never sends your health data to a server. Everything lives in this browser and, if you choose, in a URL hash you control.
footer.lgpd: Single-user tool. No doctor or patient accounts. Built to respect LGPD.

profile.title: Your medical ID
profile.lead: Fill in what a first responder or pharmacist would need. Cadence saves automatically on this device.
profile.advancedHint: Shows extra fields such as document ID, body measurements, and your clinician.
profile.notesPlaceholder: Anything else a responder should know.
profile.resetConfirm: Clear the medical ID saved on this device? This cannot be undone.

schedule.title: Daily schedule
schedule.lead: Medications grouped by morning, afternoon, evening, and bedtime. Check-offs will land here.
schedule.empty: Add medications with time slots on your profile to see a timetable.
schedule.placeholder: MiniSearch and sponsor slots plug into this page.

ads.label: Sponsor
ads.disclosure: Static sponsor message. No trackers, scripts, or external requests.

emergency.title: Emergency view
emergency.lead: High-contrast summary for first responders. Share only what you intend to share.
emergency.warning: This link puts health data in the URL. Anyone who opens it can read it. Prefer the emergency-only payload below.
emergency.empty: No profile loaded. Open your profile or a #data= link.
emergency.sourceLocal: Viewing your profile on this device

glyph.hexInvalid: Enter a valid hex color, e.g. #1a73e8

search.conditionPlaceholder: Type a condition name or ICD-10 code…
search.hint: Suggestions load in the background as you type. Free text works too.

print.title: Print and PDF
print.lead: Wallet card and daily intake templates will render from the same profile and glyphs.
print.templateA: Template A — foldable wallet card (3.375 × 2.125 in), two-sided, allergy badge, emergency QR.
print.templateB: Template B — A4 / Letter daily intake grouped Morning / Afternoon / Evening / Bedtime.
print.placeholder: jsPDF generation plugs into this page. Nothing leaves the device.

walletCard.heading: Emergency wallet card
walletCard.description: Two-panel PDF sized to fit a wallet. Fold along the middle so the QR code and contacts show on the back.
walletCard.error: Could not generate the wallet card. Try again.

dailyIntake.heading: Daily intake schedule
dailyIntake.description: Clinical medication schedule grouped by time of day, with dose, instructions, and glyph.
dailyIntake.error: Could not generate the schedule. Try again.
dailyIntake.title: Daily Intake Schedule
dailyIntake.empty: No medications with a time slot are recorded yet.

share.title: Share
share.healthDataWarning: This QR code and link contain health data. Anyone who scans or opens it can read it — only share with people you trust.
share.emergencyOnlyHint: Shares name, blood type, allergies, conditions, medications, and contacts only.
share.fullPayloadHint: Shares your full profile, including notes and clinician details.
share.qrAltEmergency: QR code linking to the emergency-only medical summary
share.qrAltFull: QR code linking to the full medical profile
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Copy the link text instead.
share.confirmFullBody: The full profile includes private notes and clinician details, not just emergency information. Anyone with this link or QR code will be able to read them.
